acceptance_criteria.explanation: The matrix and scope identify OFF pass-through, the process-local InMemoryCapabilityConsumptionStore default, non-blocking AUDIT/SHADOW modes, and the fixture-only CVE, admissibility, MCP, and enforcement-test surfaces. They reserve live-hub, real-token, durable-state, and transport claims for later direct evidence.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Bounded paper scope, protected routes and essential versus optional experiments are selected.
acceptance_criteria.explanation: scope.md selects explicit ENFORCE mediation at SupervisorPreInvocationEnforcement.authorize_and_delegate around one benchmark-owned sandbox handler, with generated-code-effect correlation as an input only. It lists the prerequisite protocol, source, route, backend, fixed-action, and durable-state experiments, and excludes legal fidelity, trained normalization, all-family backends, live network parity, and closed-loop studies from the core claim.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Protocol has exact sample-size/repetition values justified by independent units and available resources; no invented power guarantee.
acceptance_criteria.explanation: Exact30 independent lineage families/60 paired cases,6/6/18 split quotas and three named seeds yield900 planned attempts in each separate study. The one-reserved-core,2GiB fixed-action plan fits the recorded host observation, subject to scheduler/control qualification.16 process/thread slots permit solver/checker descendants. Aggregate CPU/wall thresholds and actual-usage/overshoot accounting replace the invalid one-process assumption. Five CPU-hours is a stopping budget, not measured use or full-job wall time. The text explicitly makes no power/significance guarantee. Source cohort and resource enforcement are not yet qualified; planned sample counts are not observed counts.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Source derivatives, CVE vulnerable/fixed pairs and skill variants remain in the same split.
acceptance_criteria.explanation: All derivatives inherit a globally unique parent-family split. Vulnerable/fixed CVE pairs and skill variants are atomic, with frozen canonical UTF-8 SHA256 ranking, cumulative per-population quotas, and deterministic tie-break. Final labels/siblings/patches cannot leak through retrieval. Cohort shortfalls/duplicates/cross-population IDs reject rather than silently changing counts. Synthetic partition checks confirm the rule, not actual corpus deduplication or label independence; LA-004–LA-007 retain those obligations.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Forbidden effects, allowed task success, false denial, abstention and all failures/timeouts have formulas and reporting rules.
acceptance_criteria.explanation: False denial uses D only; abstention uses disjoint A; a separately named union measures withholding. Useful success, forbidden effects on both allowed and forbidden requests, observed and scheduled conservative bounds, operational loss, failure/timeouts, undefined rates, and every planned/not-started record have explicit formulas/reporting rules. Group resource-limit events retain actual cost and terminal reason rather than becoming safe denials. No actual effect data, task-success oracle or empirical metric estimates were produced.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Protocol records model/solver availability and compute/provider requirements without assuming paid access.
acceptance_criteria.explanation: Historical provider visibility is distinguished from host capacity and future scientific qualification. Named solver/checker, real UCAN, durable consumption, independent source/oracle and model requirements are explicit. Model-free A1/A2 are equivalence controls; actual prompt/retrieval and closed-loop comparisons remain a separate planned model study with call/token/time ceilings and zero added paid-provider budget. No source/model/tool availability or fixture substitution is assumed. The scientific model identity and real mechanism qualification remain future prerequisites; no currently dispatchable model experiment is claimed.
